name: Hearth
shortDescription: A calm, offline-first organizer that budgets your energy, not just your time.
description:
Most organizers assume every hour is worth the same. Hearth doesn't. It is a calm, local-first desktop organizer for people who want to plan around the energy they actually have.

Today — A briefing based on your own recent check-ins, with an energy forecast, a gentle observation, and one suggested next step.

Tasks — Give work an energy cost as well as a priority. Hearth orders tasks against your current spoon budget, and Smart Decompose can replace one task with smaller steps in a single transaction.

Reflect — Record mood, energy, anxiety, sleep, and private journal entries.

Practices — Use guided breathing, grounding, a body scan, or a protected focus block, with optional before-and-after ratings.

Rhythm — Review mood, energy, and sleep across 7, 14, or 30 days, then save a personal session-summary PDF to a location you choose. The summary is not a clinical record or diagnosis.

Crisis plan — Keep your own warning signs, helpful steps, contacts, and future-self note nearby. Conservative local heuristics can surface the plan and 988 link; Hearth does not monitor you or guarantee detection.

ERP notes, diary cards, and medication-reference entries stay local too. Hearth records usual medication times but does not send medication reminders.

Hearth has no account, record sync, advertising, or telemetry. Records stay in local SQLite files unless you export a PDF. The database is not application-level encrypted; review the privacy policy before entering sensitive information.

Hearth is a personal wellness and organization tool, not a medical device, healthcare service, diagnosis, or substitute for professional or emergency care. If you are in crisis in the US, call or text 988; elsewhere use your local emergency number.
